exposure: Admitted for COVID-19 illness vs. other indications
cohort: 673 pregnant women infected with SARS-CoV-2 admitted to South African healthcare facilities between April 14, 2020 and November 24, 2020
finding: The maternal mortality rate was higher among women admitted with SARS-CoV-2 infection, particularly those admitted primarily for COVID-19 illness, with tuberculosis being the only co-morbidity associated with such admission.
mod_finding: Rates of cesarean delivery did not differ significantly between women admitted for COVID-19 and those admitted for other indications.
